protection.title: Coil Protection and Transport
protection.description: Visualize in 3D how Dutex's metallic and elastomeric solutions protect coils during transport, handling and storage in critical industrial operations.
protection.instructions: Play the video from start to finish or select a chapter to go directly to that segment and open the technical details.

items.title: Opening
items.description: Introduction to the Dutex protection line: overview of the video, transition between 3D scenarios and what you'll see next — from the metallic line to the plastic line, component by component.

items.title: Metallic Line
items.description: Family of steel components for cradles, reinforcements and structural coil protection: high rigidity, Dutex standardization and compatibility with strapping and movement in demanding industrial environments.

items.title: Plastic Corner Protector 70×40 mm
items.description: Polymer profile in 70×40 mm dimensions to absorb impacts and preserve outer edges during transport and storage, without marking or contaminating the wound material.

items.title: Metal sheet
items.description: Flat steel element that reinforces support or closure zones, distributing point loads and contributing to the geometric stability of the assembly on the coil.

items.title: Folded metal corner protector
items.description: Sheet corner protector with folds that increase moment of inertia and torsional resistance: edge protection with less dead weight and better steel utilization.

items.title: Steel sleeve
items.description: Metallic sleeve that wraps sensitive sections of the core or effective axis, reducing risk of crushing, friction wear and contamination during handling with equipment.

items.title: Tubular protector
items.description: Tubular component that surrounds or supports the coil periphery, preventing local deformations and offering a continuous containment surface during rolling and fastening.

items.title: Plastic Line
items.description: Set of engineering plastics solutions for impact absorption, light sealing and surface protection — complementary to the metallic line in the same Dutex design philosophy.

items.title: Plastic Corner Protector 70×40 mm
items.description: Edge reinforcement in 70×40 mm format applied in a new configuration in the video: fit designed for different diameters and package heights, maintaining the same elastomeric protection profile.

items.title: Foam mat
items.description: Technical foam layer that uniformizes contact pressures, absorbs vibrations in transport and protects sensitive finishes of tape or noble metals against micro-damage.

items.title: Plastic Corner Protector 135×70 mm
items.description: Larger profile (135×70 mm) for larger spans and radii: covers a wider area of the coil side, ideal when packaging requires a larger impact distribution area.

items.title: Top hat ring
items.description: Ring with characteristic 'top hat' geometry to protect faces or collars of the coil, center forces and facilitate alignment with straps, covers or lifting devices.

items.title: Individual cradle
items.description: Support dedicated to the coil individually: stable positioning, lower risk of coil-to-coil contact and safer operation during loading, unloading and controlled stacking.
